description: This script benchmarks the overhead of the RecordFunction in PyTorch for ResNet50 and LSTM models, including setup, warmup, and performance measurement across different thread counts and configurations.

methods.name: prepare_lstm_jit
methods.description: Prepares an LSTM model with JIT tracing based on provided benchmark arguments.

methods.name: prepare_resnet50_jit
methods.description: Prepares a ResNet50 model with JIT tracing.

methods.name: run_bench
methods.description: Runs benchmarking for specified models and arguments, measuring RecordFunction overhead.
